test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A + B' means 'A is brother of B'

'A - B' means 'A is the wife of B'

'A × B' means 'A is the son of B'

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the husband of B'

If P + Q – S + R × L ÷ M, then which of the following statements is not correct?

options.text: P is the brother of S's wife.
Q is the wife of R's brother.
M is the mother of R.

solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Wife
 Son
 Husband
 
 

 

Given: P + Q – S + R × L ÷ M

It means: P is the Brother of Q, Q is the Wife of S, S is the Brother of R, R is the Son of L, L is the Husband of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91aa9511a2b6b4b14f0005a35d777766cc5f1c95cfba16ede4b3a4ad8cf416ef.png] 

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) P is the brother of S's wife - True.

Option 2) Q is the wife of R's brother - True.

Option 3) M is the mother of R - True .

Option 4) M is sister of Q - **False **(M is the Mother-in-law of Q).

Here, Option 4 is not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
